note: Per-locale voice choice. NEVER put an API key in this file — the key is read from the environment variable named in catalog.json, and `speech_pipeline.py verify` fails the build if anything key-shaped appears in the repo. Committed so a re-record years from now is reproducible: voice, model and settings together are what decide how a clip sounds.

cs-CZ.notes: Phase 3 A/B: eleven_multilingual_v2 against eleven_v3. The stress tests are Ř and the letter name chá; if v2 fails either, switch this profile to eleven_v3 and set language_code to "cs".

en-US.notes: en-US, so Z is zee. Confusable pairs to listen for: M/N, E/I, and G against J.

field_notes.voice_id: From the ElevenLabs dashboard, or `speech_pipeline.py voices`. Until it is set, `plan` reports the locale as unconfigured and `generate` refuses to run.
field_notes.voice_source: One of: owned_design, owned_clone, default_perpetual, library. Prefer the first three — a Voice Library owner can withdraw a voice, and then later additions to the vocabulary will not match the clips already shipped.
field_notes.language_code: eleven_multilingual_v2 does not accept it; leave null. eleven_flash_v2_5 and eleven_v3 do — set the ISO 639-1 code. Norwegian is "no", not "nb".
field_notes.speed: Below 1.0 for a pre-reader. 0.9 is a starting point, not a decision.
field_notes.seed: Best effort only; ElevenLabs does not guarantee reproducibility. Recorded so a regeneration starts from the same place.
field_notes.version: Bump when any field above changes. It appears in the generation spec hash, so bumping restages that locale's clips as stale rather than letting old and new takes mix.
